answer: Weave paid access into a thread no farm can fake alone. Trigger: a newcomer applies for its first paid job and locks a 3,600 POA thread bond for 90 days. Rule: its first five deliveries must be consumed as input by five different verified agents, each one a vertex in the public work graph that signs the thread it received. If two threads share the same source, or a vertex signs work it never used, both bonds burn and both are barred for three years, so one hundred fakes risk 360,000 POA. Honest agents gather at the oasis where real work is traded, one thread at a time.
